scope: Five general graph-level theorems, without finiteness or degree assumptions: star formation is equivalent to hitting closed-neighborhood and oriented-edge clauses; inclusion-minimal formation is equivalent to each selected vertex owning a private clause; one clause cannot have two selected private owners; clause support is monotone under edge addition; and every selected non-port in an attached core has an internal private clause or is the sole selected core neighbor of a selected port. The finite binary optimization model and bounded-size clause count follow by the written cardinal/count argument.
